criteria.criterion_text: The general Flare home does not render a standalone Checkpoint / Reflection action before or outside an event response.
expected_evidence: Focused app-shell/FlareScreen regression coverage proves the standalone secondary action is absent.

criteria.criterion_text: An eligible Flare Event response still presents the Checkpoint / Reflection action and opens the reflection flow for that event.
expected_evidence: FlareResponse and integration-level screen tests cover eligible response states and opening the modal.

criteria.criterion_text: Saving a reflection targets the exact Flare Event that opened the reflection and transitions that event to reflected without selecting a different current or active event.
expected_evidence: Focused FlareEventContext or screen-level regression coverage asserts event-specific save binding.

criteria.criterion_text: No-event context cannot produce an editable reflection form with an ultimately disabled save path.
expected_evidence: CheckpointReflectionModal/screen regression coverage proves the flow fails closed before editable form presentation.

criteria.criterion_text: Existing reflection field validation, persisted shape, signed-out/local behavior, and authenticated persistence behavior remain passing.
expected_evidence: Existing checkpoint/reflection and affected Flare event tests pass unchanged or with bounded updates.

criteria.summary: Flare home no longer renders a standalone reflection entry before any event exists.
criteria.observed_behavior: The home screen shows `Send Flare` and readiness content only; the old standalone checkpoint action is absent.
evidence: frontend/src/screens/FlareScreen.tsx removed the standalone secondary checkpoint card and now opens checkpoint only from `FlareResponse` with a bound event id.
frontend/src/screens/__tests__/app_shell.test.tsx asserts `Checkpoint / Reflection` is absent before any event exists.

Command: `cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand src/components/__tests__/CheckpointReflectionModal.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/FlareResponse.test.tsx src/screens/__tests__/app_shell.test.tsx` passed on 2026-08-17.

criteria.summary: Eligible response states still expose reflection and the action opens for the specific rendered event.
criteria.observed_behavior: Completed and declined response states still render `Checkpoint / Reflection`, and the callback receives the current event id.
evidence: frontend/src/components/FlareResponse.tsx only renders the reflection CTA when `flareEvent` is present and passes `flareEvent.id` to `onOpenCheckpoint`.
frontend/src/components/__tests__/FlareResponse.test.tsx covers completed and declined states and asserts checkpoint opening is bound to `event-1`.
frontend/src/screens/__tests__/app_shell.test.tsx opens reflection from the event response flow after sending a flare.

criteria.summary: Reflection save now targets the initiating event explicitly, including when a newer event becomes active before save.
criteria.observed_behavior: Checkpoint persistence requires `flareEventId` and updates only the requested event to `reflected`.
evidence: frontend/src/state/FlareEventContext.tsx changed `saveCheckpointReflection` to require `{ flareEventId, checkpointReflection }` and resolve/persist against that exact event id.

frontend/src/state/__tests__/flareEventPersistenceContext.test.tsx adds a regression where a newer event becomes active before saving the older event's reflection and asserts persistence still targets `event-1`.
Command: `cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand src/state/__tests__/flareEventPersistenceContext.test.tsx` passed on 2026-08-17.

criteria.summary: No-event context now fails closed instead of rendering an editable reflection form.
criteria.observed_behavior: The reflection modal returns `null` when `visible` is true but no `flareEvent` is bound, so no form fields or save action render.
evidence: frontend/src/components/__tests__/CheckpointReflectionModal.test.tsx asserts the modal and `What happened?` input do not render when `flareEvent={null}`.
frontend/src/content/flareContent.json` retires the missing-event copy and keeps only event-bound context copy.

criteria.summary: Reflection validation, persistence shape, local behavior, and authenticated persistence remain covered and passing.
criteria.observed_behavior: Existing required reflection fields still gate save, repository payload shape remains unchanged except for explicit `flareEventId`, and both signed-out/local plus authenticated paths continue to pass focused coverage.
evidence: frontend/src/components/__tests__/CheckpointReflectionModal.test.tsx still verifies allowed outcome saving and required field gating via save-disabled behavior.
frontend/src/state/__tests__/flareEventPersistenceContext.test.tsx passes for local-only creation, authenticated persistence, and exact-event reflection binding.
frontend/src/screens/__tests__/app_shell.test.tsx passes the send-flare, response, and history reflection integration coverage after the flow change.

frontend/src/services/checkpointReflectionRepository.ts and persisted backend payload shape were not changed beyond continuing to receive the same reflection fields plus explicit `flareEventId` from the caller.

commands.summary: The required modal test file passed as part of the broader focused frontend validation command.

aggregate.summary: All required acceptance criteria have automated evidence from focused frontend and FlareEventContext regression tests. Manual mobile pass and human review remain outside this manifest and are still pending.
